claims_and_derivations.statement: Separate dynamical degrees of freedom, fitted inputs and independently tested predictions. Model representations and intrinsic paths are not direct observables. Antiunitary operations require phase-aware treatment; no genericKramers claim is inferred from a model label.
方向角关联DCO比值为二次多项式比二次多项式，方程退化与分母零点排除后给出二次代数方程；判别式大于零时给出两根，代数双根不保证一大一小或等权，线偏振度或寿命在有限误差包络内亦不能保证排他性排除另一解。
多极混合比delta严格定义为出射电四极与磁偶极辐射场振幅之比，与SI电荷型算符MS=Mmu/c及动量因子E/(hbar c)匹配构成无量纲量，非裸约化矩阵元之比；分母M1几何受阻即可造成较大delta。
跃迁速率与分支比关系：已知包含IC总分支比btot时lambda=btot/[tau(1+alpha)]；直接给出光子概率bgamma时lambda=bgamma/tau（不可重复除1+alpha）；相对强度由母态全出口归一；B正比于1/tau，随寿命变短而增大。
同一母态不同退激分支共享实测寿命与探测效率，存在统计协方差；严格区分刻度、拟合参数、留出检验及同采集四类协方差；分支比归一化和为1时全协方差奇异需独立坐标；在明确矩条件/高斯假定下，已知中心值与协方差矩阵支持自洽的GLS条件推断。

98Mo Table1 weak lines have globalIγ=.24(9),.74(16); strong same-mother E2 lines603.1 and475.1keV haveI8.94(45),9.89(25); E3 minimum allowed but DCO/P absent. Table2 author-pureE3 ratios are conditional. Lifetime plus complete branching distinguishes numerator enhancement from denominator hindrance; a failure tests the specified transition/model implementation, not every octupole correlation.

102Ru NRF constrainsΓ0²/Γ;0+→1− isE1 in the stated single-photon experiment. PDF3supports2953.2(19)keV andB1up=.016 plus E1cluster≈.1. Intrinsic rank1/rank3 effective expression is model-specific; a covariantlab expansion may contain[Q2⊗O3]1. Harmonic B2 strength does not force dominant photonE2 branching; rates include constants,energy powers andICC.

135Pr specific negative-parity747.3 line supports small-|δ| in Lv dataset; compare complete electromagnetic predictions with consistent inputs and uncertainty. Lawrie frozen-qp TiP test, LvQTR reorientation and NomuraIBFM are distinct implementations. No universalE2fraction or low-spin threshold follows.
